watchFor: TSV 形成、填孔及晶粒堆疊是不同責任的工序。
凸塊均勻性與電鍍空洞需要各自的量測證據。
影片展示設備能力方向；沒有給出可投產的完整製程窗口。
watchForEn: TSV formation, via filling and die stacking are separate process responsibilities.
Bump uniformity and plating voids need different measurement evidence.
The video introduces equipment capabilities, not a complete qualified production window.
videos.scope: 本課「晶圓薄化與背面研磨」的延伸背景。先進封裝設備與材料處理的共同背景；並非 TSMC、Intel 或每一特殊封裝的製程紀錄。 影片並非本課每一道步驟的實拍。
videos.scopeEn: Related background for Wafer thinning and backside grinding. Shared equipment and materials-processing context for advanced packaging, not a process record for TSMC, Intel or every package type. It is not footage of every step in this course.
videos.titleEn: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.originalTitle: Inside the Chip: How Lam Research Solves Advanced Packaging Challenges for the AI Era
videos.author: Lam Research
videos.captionNote: 字幕與翻譯由原平台提供；下列中英重點由本學院依官方介紹另行撰寫，不是逐字稿或時間軸。
videos.captionNoteEn: Captions and translations depend on the source platform. The bilingual points are original academy guides based on official descriptions, not a transcript or timestamped account.
videos.before: 先問：「最終厚度分配」需要哪種材料或介面證據？畫出本課與影片案例的共同處及不同處。
videos.beforeEn: Ask what material or interface evidence Final-thickness allocation requires. Draw the common ground and differences between this course and the video case.
videos.after: 把「邊緣缺口」列為查證任務：保留圓周缺陷圖與搬運方向。 請分開列出符合預測與不符合預測的位置或樣本。
videos.afterEn: Follow-up evidence task for Edge chipping: Retain circumferential defect maps and handling directions. Report locations or samples agreeing and disagreeing with the prediction separately.

courses.overview: 依接口學習相近工法：薄化幾何、次表面損傷與薄片支撐。每個比較保留共同機制及不可直接轉移的邊界。
courses.overviewEn: Learn related methods through interfaces: Thinning geometry, subsurface damage and thin-wafer support. Each comparison retains both shared mechanisms and nontransferable boundaries.

related.title: 晶圓暫時接合與解接合
related.why: 膠層與載板均勻性是研磨幾何的前置輸入
related.whyEn: Adhesive and carrier uniformity precede grinding geometry
related.transfer: 膠層與載板均勻性是研磨幾何的前置輸入
related.transferEn: Adhesive and carrier uniformity precede grinding geometry
related.difference: 暫時接合重在支撐釋放，本課分析材料移除與損傷
related.differenceEn: Temporary bonding emphasizes support/release; this course analyzes removal/damage
practice: 以「最終厚度分配」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「目標厚度須扣除後續應力釋放和露出加工留量。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「畫厚度預算的逐站瀑布圖。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use final-thickness allocation to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Final thickness must reserve later stress-relief and reveal allowances.
Using "Draw a station-by-station thickness waterfall.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.

related.difference: 整体減薄與局部金屬露出有不同終點和選擇比需求
related.differenceEn: Bulk thinning and local metal reveal need different endpoints/selectivities
practice: 以「厚度量測基準」畫出兩課的材料或資料交接，標明共同基準。
比較「透明保護層、背面反射與探頭校正會影響厚度讀值。」在另一工法下還缺少哪項邊界條件。
用本課的「用可追溯標準片與另一方法交叉校核。」設計一項可轉移和一項不可直接轉移的驗收證據。
practiceEn: Use thickness reference to draw material/data handoffs and shared datums.
Identify missing boundary conditions when applying this mechanism to the other process: Transparent protection, backside reflections and probe calibration affect readings.
Using "Cross-check with traceable standards and a second method.", define one transferable and one nontransferable acceptance item.
